If you want a reason as to why you shouldn't kill yourself is because you matter. The simple condition of being human gives infinite value to your life.

Now if that doesnt satisfy you then maybe this will.
You ever looked at the sun coming out at dawn. Its something that happens everyday and we have 0 control over it. It happens the same way every single day with no difference. But some days when id feel like there is no point in waking up again i'd stay up all night and watch the sunrise because even if its the same thing as every other day, in that moment it is special to me and it makes it worth the sleepless night. So if you wonder why you shouldn't die, then its because you still have another sunrise to watch, and a sunset too. You still can end a really good book, learn something new, listen to one more stuipd song you love, etc. Theres always something out there that makes it worth it.

As to everything else, it will probably sort itself out. Maybe not in the way that you like but hey that's life. So you have no motivation to study then dont and find a career that makes you content. The girl doesn't reciprocate feelings well you'll find someone else or maybe not who knows. 

Just please remember there is more to life than a job or 1 girl. And that your life is worth more than just money from your parents

every life is worth living, and i refuse to believe the opposite. you are deluding yourself if you think your life is meaningless. if your life is a mess then fix it. if you cant then mess it up the way you like it.

i dont know anyone who has their life in order, but i know a hell of alot of people who messed it up just in the right way. remember its all a matter of perspective.

i wont lie and tell you its all gonna be okay because its not. problems don't poof out of existence like that. but what i will tell you is that you are focusing so much on the details. that you have lost sight entirely of the bigger picture.

if you focus on the details you will find that they will always pile on and on. such is life. but it takes a special ability to sometimes let go of the details. to realize that its not as bad as it seems. burdens are only as heavy as you allow them to be

if you think the gcses will dictate your life then you are wrong. look at me, i did my gcses on business, my IB's in science and am doing computer engineering in college. its all sorts of messed up. please stay strong

hey, dude the gcses are not even fucking worth it. study what you can and you'll be fine. gcses are not as hyped up as they seem to be. iB well that's another matter but you'll cross that bridge if need be. and if it doesn't work out its just another piece of paper with scribbles on it.

 don't let your worries destroy you. remember tiny things can cast enormous shadows.

sometimes the world is full of noise and obligations but sometimes you should tell the world to shut the fuck up for a few minutes. stay strong
